name: Sodium smart-account session-key validation bypass draining wallet gas deposits and Lumi Finance users
summary: Sodium wallets validate an executeWithSodiumAuthSession userOp when the calldata session key equals the signature's self-declared ERC-1271 signer, deferring the real auth proof to execution. An attacker contract as signer passed validation, so wallets paid inflated gas prefunds to the attacker as bundler beneficiary and approved attacker paymasters for tokens then pulled with transferFrom.

campaign.selection: transactions not sent by 0xce1a3bb0 or bundler 0xee1f058c in which a Sodium wallet (proxy runtime keccak 0x5b50b88c3767222ffbb152eddb5aa6ce3af2b2d3d210574a31752a2f64c0b221) emits an EntryPoint v0.6 UserOperationEvent or sends a token; wallets from UserOperationEvents in blocks 483300000-486300000

notes: Targets are the 300 Sodium wallets the anchor executed, 292 on implementation 0xb5bc46df and 8 on 0x46516e84; each proxy keeps its implementation in its own address-keyed slot, set at creation and never changed, so each ages from creation and the youngest sets the age.

Campaign: 0x7bd73663's eight CREATE transactions come first, each running 300 different wallets' userOps (2400 in all) with execution starved of gas so the wallets paid inflated prefunds, 17.740288 ETH, to its helper as beneficiary; then the Lumi attacker's transactions (its EOA and the bundler relaying its paymaster ops); the copycat tail (0xcccc6400, 0xdd9f1fbe, ten-plus others) is a bundle. Gas-only drains after block 486300000 were not scanned. EntryPoint deposits are victims in paymaster-less transactions.

No earlier exploit: from implementation 0xb5bc46df's deployment (block 142595379) to the anchor, all 50,900 EntryPoint ops of the 2,400 drained wallets and the Lumi anchor's 19 were bundled by Sodium's own 0xc1b965a9, with no op costing over 0.11 ETH.

LUAUSD and LUA are valued at realised proceeds (rule 12): LUAUSD at the first attacker's Curve sales, 48399.605758 USDT0 for 74480.72, whose selling crashed it; LUA, whose pools held under $100 and DefiLlama quote is stale, at the $51.79 its sellers got. Unrealised LUAOP, LUAB, LUAG PTS and TRUMP are omitted.
